method: Fresh built-in GPT Image attempts (lead-run Sol lane) from real-palette native 8x pose references, the owner-approved powered concept, the model sheet and approved normal sprites; fixed anatomical scale per image; mode filter of a third of a native pixel, then centre (nearest) sampling at the grid phase with the most uniform samples; palette-role indexing; ink bounding plates/plumage and the outer silhouette joins contour slot 2; single-pixel material despeckle. Slopes derived with derive_slopes.derive at the replaced frames' support distance. No native pixels shipped.
selection: MICA: wait v1, run v2 (boots), roll v1, transformation v1. TALON: wait v2, run v2 (darker chest bars), roll v2, transformation v1 (pale wrapped first beat).

plan.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production 1990s Sega Genesis / Mega Drive sprite art, exactly like the native sprites in image 1: hard square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no glow, cel shading with two or three flat shade steps per material, light from the upper left, a dark one-pixel outline, at most 15 colours. Each sprite is drawn LARGE (about 8x) on a plain flat mid-grey background, one sprite per equal grid cell, no text, no labels, no numbers, no ground shadows, no rings, no effects or sparkles outside the body. She is MICA, an original jade pangolin (image 3 is her approved model sheet; image 4 is her approved in-game sprites at 8x and LOCKS her head size, torso size, eye shape and pixel style). Keep from the model sheet: soft round sand-cream face and pointed snout, large brown eyes with lashes, small pink ears, ridged cream belly, white gloves, and HER OWN CORAL-RED BOOTS with tan treaded soles and teal laces (never sneakers, never Sonic's shoes). Her armour is overlapping PANGOLIN SCALE PLATES, each broad and rounded, WIDER THAN IT IS LONG. Never quills, spikes, spines, hair or fur. No resemblance to Sonic or any Sega character. POWERED FORM 'GILDED MICA', direction OPEN CONE, exactly as in image 2 (the owner-approved concept): every scale plate on her back, head crest and tail has LIFTED on its hinge like a pine cone opening, so her outline is a bold stepped sawtooth of five or six large rounded plate tips pointing up and back, the tail fans into a wide serrated leaf, and the head-crest plates rise into a tiered swept-back cowl. IMPORTANT CHANGE FROM IMAGE 2: the topmost crown plate has NO curly flick and NO curled hook at its tip; every crown plate rises as a STRAIGHT, broad, POINTED plate. Plates are polished GOLD: pale-gold upper edge, gold and yellow faces, deep amber underside showing in the gap under each lifted plate. Face, belly, gloves and boots keep their model-sheet colours. Set, confident brow. Image 1 is the native standing/breathing poses in their real game palette at 8x: top row S2 frames $72,$73,$74, bottom row S3K frames $BA,$BB. Draw FIVE sprites in a 3-column, 2-row grid in the same cells (bottom-right cell empty), each copying the matching native pose's stance, facing, head tilt, arm and foot placement and size: feet planted, fists closed, chin down. The plates BREATHE: in each row the frames alternate between plates at full lift and plates settled about one pixel lower, so the sawtooth outline visibly rises and settles.
